card.name: Protein binding in overdose notes
card.fires_on: The word 'binding' or 'protein' in phrases like 'highly protein bound' or 'high protein binding', mostly in overdose and dialysis sentences. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated verbs like 'ride' or 'using'.

modes.label: Protein binding of a drug
modes.description: 'binding' or 'protein' in statements that a drug is highly bound to plasma protein, often explaining why dialysis will not help.
modes.example: Hemodialysis or hemoperfusion is unlikely to reduce entacapone levels due to its high<< binding>> to plasma proteins.

modes.label: Stray verbs in general text
modes.description: Occasional verbs such as 'ride' or 'using' in non-drug prose about spiders or pulleys.
